title: Sell or connect only approved gas appliances
what: Sell, or connect to a consumer piping system, only gas appliances approved (type A appliances certified, type B approved by the construction occupations registrar).

sources.title: Gas Safety Act 2000 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 23(1) (current republication (R23, from 23 February 2026; Gas Safety Act 2000 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if the person— (a) sells a gas appliance; and (b) the gas appliance is not approved
